title: Protection
html:
Protection is a Fighting Style reaction/passive feature. Users can interfere with an enemy targetting one of your nearby allies.

Description

When you have a Shield, impose  Disadvantage on an enemy who attacks one of your allies when you are within 1.5 m (5 ft). You must be able to see the enemy.

Details

Cost:
 Reaction

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 1: Fighter
  • Class level 2: Paladin

Used by creatures:

  • Aguta, Bakshi, Breva Brightmoon, Brottor, Callaway, Cragbender, Creekrider, Dain, Darbonna, Devella Fountainhead, Diallo, Discoria, Duranga, Edenosa, Edwynna, Fist Defender, Ghainemeir, Grassley, Habor Koltz, Halantow, Ingram, Jagic, Jepsen, Lady Ague, Lady Quinsy, Larys, Madstene, Malayah, Meadows, Murphy, Norys, Nudelmann, Okralope, Osmund, Pagnola, Phanellis, Poole, Richter, Rockbreed, Rowan (Requisitioned Barn), Shah, Smithwynn, Soapstone, Syllving, Thunder (Flaming Fist), Ulinn, Wayne, Williams

Notes

  • Characters cannot use this on themselves.

Bugs

  • This reaction cannot be used while affected by  Starry Form or when  Disguised.
